The main takeaway from our work is that
the combination of a stress perfusion scan with a stress/rest scan is more predictive of future cardiac events than a single stress perfusion scan.

the combination of stress and rest myocardial perfusion imaging (MPI) provides incremental prognostic information over and above that provided by stress-only MPI, and that the addition of rest imaging provides the greatest incremental prognostic value for patients with a history of prior coronary artery disease.
